_comment: Every entry below encodes a failure mode that a return code cannot see.
Paths are relative to the working directory; run from the repo root after
producing the artifacts, or rewrite them.
Note: '_comment' is not a recognised spec key and will be rejected if
placed inside an artifact object — it is legal only at this top level
because parse_spec ignores keys it does not read.

artifacts.label: rendered-report
artifacts._why: min_pages_pdf=2 catches a header-only shell; must_contain proves the body reached the renderer; must_not_contain is the unsubstituted-template guard

artifacts.label: diagram-png
artifacts._why: exact dimensions catch DPI/scale conversion errors, which are off by one or by a factor, never by chance

artifacts.label: generated-script
artifacts._why: a generator that hits an unsupported input often emits a WARNING comment and continues; the script still runs, so only the text check sees it
